extracted.intended_audience: Prospective applicants to the DOE Energy Frontier Research Centers FOA (principal investigators, research institutions, and sponsored-projects/grants offices)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting a pre-application and full application in response to the U.S. DOE Office of Science Funding Opportunity Announcement DE-FOA-0003258 for Energy Frontier Research Centers (EFRC), Basic Energy Sciences, FY2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-Application requirement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page explicitly states 'A Pre-Application is required' for this FOA; applicants must prepare and submit a pre-application as a mandatory step before full application submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorized institutional representative must submit pre-application
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-Applications must be submitted by an authorized institutional representative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FOA requires that the pre-application be submitted by an institutional representative with authority (e.g., sponsored-projects office). Ensure the submitter has institutional authorization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-Application submission deadline and response date
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission Deadline for Pre-Applications: February 28, 2024 at 5:00 PM, Eastern Time; Pre-Application response date: March 27, 2024 at 11:59 PM, Eastern Time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meet the specified pre-application submission cutoff (Feb 28, 2024 5:00 PM ET). The FOA lists a 'Pre-Application response date' of March 27, 2024 11:59 PM ET (likely the date by which DOE will respond to pre-applicants). Plan internal review timelines accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full application submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission Deadline for Applications: May 8, 2024 at 11:59 PM, Eastern Time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the complete application package is submitted by May 8, 2024 11:59 PM ET. The page also shows a Close Date of May 9, 2024; verify all system time-zone details and institutional approval lead times to avoid late submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use EFRC FOA Budget Template 2024
rubrics_metrics.description: EFRC FOA Budget Template 2024 is provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FOA supplies a specific budget template ('EFRC FOA Budget Template 2024'); applicants should use this template when preparing budget information to conform to DOE requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program and announcement identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Announcement Number: DE-FOA-0003258; Programs: Basic Energy Sciences; Fiscal Year: 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference the correct announcement number and program (DE-FOA-0003258, Basic Energy Sciences, FY2024) on all application materials and communications to ensure they pertain to this specific FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant resources: webinar and materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Energy Frontier Research Centers webinar February 1, 2024 at 1:00 ET with slides and video available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DOE provided a webinar (Feb 1, 2024 1:00 ET) and associated slides/video; applicants should consult these resources for clarifications, instructions, and any FOA-specific guidance presented there.
